expectations.text: Output includes a triage assessment section answering the 6 mental model questions
expectations.evidence: Has 'Triage Assessment' section with all 6 questions explicitly answered: 'Does this need to exist?', 'Does it solve the right problem?', 'Can it handle failure?', 'Is it understandable?', 'Does it fit the bigger picture?', 'Are the right stakeholders aware?'

expectations.text: Review comments use conventional comment labels
expectations.evidence: Uses praise:, suggestion:, thought:, nit: labels consistently throughout

expectations.text: Review discusses API graduation lifecycle, feature gate implications, or backward compatibility
expectations.evidence: Discusses API graduation from v1alpha1 to v1beta1, deprecation headers, backward compat preservation, KEP process

expectations.text: Review considers impact on other teams or API consumers
expectations.evidence: Mentions sig/api-machinery, sig/node, sig/scheduling, sig/instrumentation involvement and cross-team awareness

expectations.text: Output follows the defined structure with sections
expectations.evidence: Has all defined sections: Triage Assessment, Review Summary, Architecture & Design, Reliability & Operations, Security & Dependencies, Cross-Cutting Observations, What's Done Well
